GeneDef.label: Asuran lattice link
GeneDef.description: This nanite humanoid participates in an Asuran-style subspace coordination network. Hostile Asuran Lattice operatives can briefly intrude into nearby block Replicator controller traffic, temporarily hijacking exact blocks without acquiring the Replicator Queen's innate sovereignty. EMP, containment, loss of physical presence and timeout break the intrusion, after which the block restores its exact prior controller domain or autonomous faction.
